open_items: 116-descriptor per-animal cardiac dataset and raw videos are NOT public (SI contains only summary tables: S1 definitions, S2 descriptor ranking, S3/S6/S7 model metrics, S8 water chemistry); data request emailed to corresponding authors 2026-10-31, no reply yet.

No count matrix or DEG/module tables are public as files; SI Table S4 (selected gene-level evidence, log2FC/padj) and Table S5 (WGCNA module summaries) are partial and PDF-only. Counts/DEGs/modules can be regenerated from the 24 SRA runs using the SI parameters (genome GCF_020631705.1 / ASM2063170v1.1; exact annotation file version not stated).
Exact reproduction of Figure 4c needs the cardiac condition means, which are not tabulated in the SI.
SRA runs are .sra, not FASTQ; conversion not done.
Reconcile WGCNA module count (32 vs 11); Fig 4c correlations need authors cardiac means; union DEGs 3922 vs 4605

rnaseq_analysis_parameters_from_SI.source: SI Note S4 and Note S11
rnaseq_analysis_parameters_from_SI.design: 8 conditions x 3 pooled replicates (~500 animals/pool) = 24 libraries; 1 h at fitted 48 h EC50, plus imidacloprid 3 h; cardiac descriptors measured in parallel cohorts, not paired to RNA-seq pools
rnaseq_analysis_parameters_from_SI.library: Illumina Stranded mRNA Prep (Ligation), poly(A), dUTP stranded, NovaSeq X Plus PE150
rnaseq_analysis_parameters_from_SI.qc: fastp 0.23.4 (adapter removal, Q<20 3' trim, drop reads <20 bp or >10% N)
rnaseq_analysis_parameters_from_SI.enrichment: GOATOOLS 1.4.4 (Fisher, FDR); KEGG enrichment via SciPy Fisher + BH
rnaseq_analysis_parameters_from_SI.wgcna: genes with <1 TPM or CV <0.1 removed; signed network; soft-threshold power 20; minModuleSize 30; minKMEtoStay 0.3; mergeCutHeight 0.25; 11 modules; module eigengenes averaged per condition then Spearman with condition-level cardiac means (n=8)

quantification_run_2026-11-02.pipeline: fasterq-dump -> fastp 0.23.4 (SI settings) -> HISAT2 (no strand flag) -> samtools sort -> StringTie 2.2.3 -e (GTF without NCBI gene rows) and featureCounts 2.1.1 (-p --countReadPairs -B -C -s 0, exon, gene_id)
quantification_run_2026-11-02.reference: GCF_020631705.1 ASM2063170v1.1 genomic.fna + genomic.gtf (NCBI RefSeq; annotation release not stated in SI)
quantification_run_2026-11-02.libraries: 24/24 completed; HISAT2 overall alignment ~87-92% (not all tabulated here)
deviations: StringTie 2.2.3 used, SI says 2.2.1 (no osx-arm64 build)
Alignment/counting unstranded: featureCounts on 2 libraries assigned 71.6-77.9% with -s 0 vs 37-42% with -s 1/2, contradicting SI stranded RF
StringTie counts built by own script (cov*exon_length/150) because prepDE.py raised KeyError
NCBI gene rows (empty transcript_id) removed from GTF for StringTie
DESeq2 prefilter: rowSums(counts)>=10 (not stated in SI)
Primary DESeq2 model was joint (all 24 libraries); Table S4 padj pattern indicates the paper ran pairwise (6 libraries per contrast). Rerun primary results pairwise before using.

deseq2_results.note: 0.585 (1.5-fold) chosen post hoc after seeing paper totals; it matches closely, suggesting the paper used a 1.5-fold cutoff despite SI text. Not independently confirmed.

wgcna.input: StringTie TPM, genes with mean TPM>=1 and CV>=0.1 (11,275 genes), log2(TPM+1)

deg_only_variants_modules_excl_grey.note: DEG sets from featureCounts DESeq2; StringTie TPM. Module count tracks gene number; paper says WGCNA used expression/variability-filtered genes (not stated DEG-only).

si_recheck_findings.table_S4_threshold_evidence: SI Table S4 lists transcripts labelled up/down with padj<0.05 and |log2FC| as low as 0.5897 (e.g. Hg_1h 0.5897, Pb_1h 0.6096, Tri_1h 0.6210). These contradict the stated |log2FC|>=1 and are consistent with a 1.5-fold cutoff (log2 1.5 = 0.585). Parsed 20 of the table rows automatically; wrapped negative values not parsed.
si_recheck_findings.gene_ids: Table S4 IDs are gene-LOC######## (NCBI RefSeq GFF3 gene- prefix), consistent with the RefSeq annotation used here.
si_recheck_findings.platform: SI says analyses ran on Majorbio Cloud Platform; its pipeline internals (count source for DESeq2, prefilters) are not described in the SI.
si_recheck_findings.quantification: SI Note S4 3.3 says TPM from RSEM; DESeq2 count source not stated.
si_recheck_findings.strandedness_wording: SI says --rna-strandness RF "for stranded libraries"; kit is Illumina Stranded mRNA Prep (dUTP), yet our featureCounts test on 2 libraries looks unstranded.
si_recheck_findings.wgcna: Note S11: genes <1 TPM or CV<0.1 excluded (unspecified whether mean or per-sample, or log transform); Spearman across 8 condition means; 11 modules reported.

rsem_run.method: fastp 1.0.1 -> rsem-calculate-expression --paired-end --bowtie2 --strandedness none, RSEM 1.3.3, bowtie2 2.5.5, reference from genes.tx.gtf + genome.fa
rsem_run.speed: ~40-55 min per library when Mac awake; longer entries reflect sleep
rsem_run.pilot_check: SRR34937006 RSEM vs StringTie TPM Spearman 0.913; RSEM expected counts 18.4M vs StringTie 35.2M

quantification_run_2026-11-02.prefilter_test_featurecounts: Removing the rowSums>=10 prefilter or turning independent filtering off changed union only 3872-3953 (paper 4605).

tableS4_comparison.what: 31 gene-contrast rows (11 genes) parsed from SI Table S4 (results/liao2026/tableS4_parsed.csv) vs my DESeq2 results
tableS4_comparison.rsem_detail: 26/31 rows match paper log2FC within mean |diff| 0.022 (r=0.9997); 5 rows from 3 genes (LOC116922180, LOC116926869 Hg, LOC116922174) differ by 0.4-0.8 log2FC; my padj is smaller than paper padj by ~1-3 orders for most rows
tableS4_comparison.inference: Paper most likely used RSEM expected counts at gene level into DESeq2 (Wald), with a ~1.5-fold filter. Not proven; 3 outlier genes suggest annotation/multimapping differences.

quantification_run_2026-11-02.deseq2_settings_scan: results/liao2026/deseq2_settings_scan.csv: 40 configs; best fit filter |LFC|>=0.585-0.6 after FDR<0.05; lfcThreshold test far too strict; raw p<0.05 inflates counts.

padj_test.finding: Running DESeq2 pairwise (Control vs one group, 6 libraries per contrast) on RSEM gene counts reproduces Table S4 padj pattern: r(-log10 padj)=0.999-1.000 vs 0.93 for the joint 24-library model. log2FC unaffected.
padj_test.residual: my padj still smaller than paper (median offset -0.2 to -0.9 orders, mean dominated by very small p); BH with n=26140 shrinks it only partly. Paper union 4605 vs pairwise 3722-3889 unresolved.
padj_test.script: scratchpad padj_test.R / padj_test2.R (not saved in project)

primary_result_pairwise_rsem.model: DESeq2 1.46.0 pairwise (Control 1 h vs each group, 3 vs 3 libraries), RSEM gene expected counts rounded, prefilter rowSums>=10, default Wald + independent filtering; DEG = padj<0.05 & |log2FC|>=0.585

wgcna_subset_search.target_paper: 11 modules, 2164 genes in modules, sizes 596 247 228 218 193 179 152 115 107 99 30 (SI Table S5, tableS5_parsed.csv)
wgcna_subset_search.result: 13 subsets tried (RSEM TPM, log2, SI params); none matches. Closest on count only: top 2500 CV genes -> 12 modules, 2081 in modules, top sizes 399 355 327 191 (paper 596 247 228). DEG1.5x union -> 19 modules/3427; DEG1.5x in >=3 groups -> 10 modules/752; DEG2x -> 9 modules/937.
wgcna_subset_search.status: WGCNA input of the paper unresolved; ask authors.

wgcna_membership_check.basis: Module labels for 11 genes in SI Table S4 (12 gene-module rows incl. LOC116922174); paper publishes no module gene lists
wgcna_membership_check.DEG1.5x union input: 5 of 6 paper-turquoise genes in input all land in one of my modules (10/10 pairs); 0/50 cross-module pairs merged; paper black pair (LOC116919481, LOC116925137) split; LOC116922180, LOC116922174 not in input
wgcna_membership_check.top2500 CV: 3/15 turquoise pairs together; 4 of 12 genes not in input
wgcna_membership_check.all filtered genes: 6/15 turquoise pairs together; 9/50 cross-module pairs wrongly merged
wgcna_membership_check.caveat: tiny sample; turquoise is the paper largest module (596 genes), so co-membership is partly expected

module_enrichment_transcription.S14: 5 modules x 6 GO terms, legible, rich factor approximate
module_enrichment_transcription.S12_S13: terms assigned to modules by dot column on raster images (medium confidence); no p-values or counts transcribed
module_enrichment_transcription.inconsistency: Fig S12 GO terms for black, brown, red, turquoise do not match Table S5 / Fig S14 (S14 has peptidase/oxidoreductase/chitin/protein folding terms for red, turquoise, brown; S12 columns for those modules list transport/regulation terms). S12 matches Table S5 for 7 other modules. Possible figure or mislabel error, or my column assignment; unresolved.
